text:
anya: Heads up — sharp spike in JSON-formatting failures on AWQ-int8 candidates when interleaved batching is enabled on dedicated pools. Repro below. :eyes:

sam: Which model + profile?

anya: model: open-llama-7b-v2 (hf->redwood), quant: awq-int8, kernel: avx2, batching: interleaved, batch_size: 8, seq_len var: 32-1024

anya: sample failing output (expected a single JSON object per example, now multiple lines and key reordering):
```json
{"id":1,"name":"Alice","items":[{"qty":1}]}
}]
"id":1"name":"Alice"
```

sam: hmm looks like token stream merge — could be KV cache boundary or buffer reuse. Any recent runtime changes?

leo: did this start after the interleave change earlier today?

deploy-bot: rollout/runtime: interleave-shuffle fix v2 deployed at 2024-11-08T10:05Z (build b-314)

marta: also check mixed-batch padding; AWQ's inner loop does per-chunk packing — if tokens from different requests share a ring buffer we can get interleaving artifacts.

ci-bot: can you paste minimal repro script? run `pytest tests/quant/interop/test_interleave_hiccup.py::test_json_noise -k awq --runslow`

anya: repro gist: 
```python
# repro
from redwood_client import InferenceClient
client = InferenceClient(api_key="redacted")
inputs = ["{\"id\":%d, \"name\":\"Alice\"}" % i for i in range(8)]
resp = client.generate(model="open-llama-7b-v2-awq-int8", inputs=inputs, interleave=True, batch_size=8)
print(resp[0]['text'])
```

sam: try set `kv_cache_shard='per-request'` or `interleave=False` to confirm; if it goes away that points to runtime buffer reuse.

anya: disabling interleave dropped error rate from 7.8% -> 0.2% on our TableX eval (5k examples, policy: strict JSON match). Repro artifacts cluster near sequence boundaries (short prompt followed by long generation).

leo: can you repro on GPTQ-int8 too?

anya: AWQ-only so far, will try GPTQ tonight. Early signal suggests AWQ packing logic is involved.

marta: logging: please capture raw token ids around the boundary and include per-chunk offsets. Adding header `X-Trace: interleave=bucket-3` in requests helps correlate traces.

anya: attached token dump and eval numbers in the shared drive link (redacted link) :link:

sam: next steps: 1) prod smoke with interleave off for the affected dedicated pool, 2) add a runtime guard to prevent buffer reuse across request shards, 3) triage AWQ kernel packing/padding handling.

leo: can add A/B rollback: route 10% traffic to a non-interleaved variant as a canary.

marta: filed INF-5923, assigned to eng-runtime; note: reproduces on avx2 kernels only (intel gen9). No repro on CUDA or NEON so far.

anya: thanks all, will post update after GPTQ run. :thumbsup:
